sphere.name: Sphere
sphere.manifesto: Rounded geometry and quiet volume. Sphere holds space with softness — bouclé, ball feet, and silhouettes that settle rather than announce.
sphere.lede: Four volumes, one curve. Table, orbit, pouf, and bench — bouclé and stone held in quiet roundness.

retro.name: Retro
retro.manifesto: Tubular steel and striped textile in cinematic shade. Retro is outdoor light held still — orange frame, long shadow, a lounge that belongs to air more than to a room.

tiles.name: Tiles
tiles.manifesto: Rhythm, grid, and glaze. Tiles is an exploration of presence — ceramic, walnut, and a playing field held in exact proportion.
tiles.lede: Four objects, one grid. Bench, table, pouf, and Rove — glaze standing in wood, grout holding the measure.

fringes.name: Fringes
fringes.manifesto: Movement in still objects. Fringes is tactile layering — fringe, pile, and colour that asks to be felt before it is named.

sphere-bench.name: The Onda Bench
sphere-bench.description: A low seating form draped in a labyrinthine weave, resting on three spherical hardwood volumes.

lounge-chair.name: The Boule Lounge Chair
lounge-chair.description: A low sculptural seating form defined by floating arms, olive leather, and a spherical wooden foot.

commode.name: The Forma Commode
commode.description: A darkened wooden chest whose drawer fronts carry a continuous rust-orange textile field, lifted on spherical feet.

folded-pouf.name: The Folded Pouf
folded-pouf.description: A cylindrical seating volume with a leather wrap that rises into a short back — a fold held by a single metal stud.

sphere-ottoman.name: The Nubo Pouf
sphere-ottoman.description: A tapered cylindrical ottoman in sketched ivory weave, grounded by four glossed spherical feet.

orbit-coffee-table.name: The Orbit Table
orbit-coffee-table.description: A low table whose mass orbits a spherical presence — proportion over ornament.

coffee-table-iii.name: The Bubbly Console
coffee-table-iii.description: A long ivory plane lifted on stacked olive spheres — volume clustered into structure.

lobe-coffee-table.name: The Sphera Table
lobe-coffee-table.description: Two warm hardwood planes, stacked in an organic drift, held by spherical volumes.

wave-coffee-table.name: The Sphere Table
wave-coffee-table.description: A glass plane that folds toward the floor, lifted at the far end by a single hardwood sphere.

stem-side-table.name: Stem Side Table
stem-side-table.description: A small circular plane on a slender stem, weighted by a sphere at the base.

backgammon-table.name: The Tawla Table
backgammon-table.description: A pedestal table with a copper playing field set in a rounded white plane, above a relief-cast, earth-toned base.

steel-lounge-chair.name: The Steel Chair
steel-lounge-chair.description: Tubular steel in orange, striped cushions, shade cut across colour — a lounge for outdoor light.

tiled-bench.name: The Tiled Bench
tiled-bench.description: Cushioned linen volumes on a walnut plane, supported by a glazed ceramic plinth — architecture at seating height.

tiled-coffee-table.name: The Tiled Coffee Table
tiled-coffee-table.description: A dark wood frame carrying a field of standing ceramic blocks — glaze, grout, and geometric rhythm.

tiled-pouf.name: The Tiled Pouf
tiled-pouf.description: A mosaic cube in coral glaze, capped with a powder-blue cushion. Grid below, softness above.

fringes-pouf.name: The Tango Pouf
fringes-pouf.description: A cylindrical seating form split between burnt-orange pile and a falling field of teal fringe.

about.title: Furniture as art.
about.lede: NO FORM explores the space between sculpture and function. Each piece is a functional object and an artistic statement — defined by bold silhouettes, refined detailing, tactile richness, and architectural presence.
about.body: Luxury is found in restraint: in proportion, material honesty, precision, and atmosphere. We create collectible furniture designed to be experienced, remembered, and lived with.
about.craftLine: Burl, inlay, and the patience of the studio — pieces meant to be lived with daily.
about.close: We do not simply furnish spaces. We shape them.

artistic.title: Artistic expression
artistic.body: Every piece is an exploration of form, movement, and emotion.

sculptural.title: Sculptural design
sculptural.body: We challenge conventions and embrace bold silhouettes.

craft.title: Luxury craftsmanship
craft.body: The highest quality materials, finishes, and artisanal execution.

function.title: Functional purpose
function.body: Beauty and comfort exist together in balance.

architecture.title: Architectural presence
architecture.body: Our objects shape space, create atmosphere, and leave an impression.

timeless.title: Timeless identity
timeless.body: Designed to transcend trends and become collectible over time.

styling.title: How a room begins to breathe.
styling.lede: Four compositions. Not a catalogue — a way of seeing.
styling.body: These are rooms the studio imagined until the pieces found each other. Sit with them. Let the light do the introducing.
styling.close: We do not decorate. We see.

night.title: Night, composed.
night.body: A bed that is a volume. A commode like a small planet. The Onda bench waits at the foot of sleep.

sitting.title: The hour the light stays.
sitting.body: A sofa that turns like a thought. Leather at rest. Tables that are not placed — they belong.

terrace.title: Green that remembers the sea.
terrace.body: Glaze catching the afternoon. Steel sitting open. The air does the rest.

threshold.title: A pause before the house.
threshold.body: Colour as architecture. You sit, and the room begins.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: When you order, enquire, or create an account we collect your name, email, phone number, and delivery address. We do not store card details — payments are handled by our payment provider.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To fulfil orders, deliver pieces, answer enquiries, and send transactional emails about your order. We do not sell or share your data with third parties beyond delivery and payment partners needed to complete your order.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use a small number of first-party cookies to keep your cart, keep you signed in, and remember your language. No advertising cookies are set.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us to correct or delete your data at any time by writing to the studio.

sections.title: Orders
sections.body: Placing an order reserves the pieces for you. The order is confirmed only when the studio has received the deposit described below and verified availability. Prices are in Egyptian pounds and include VAT unless stated otherwise.

sections.title: Deposit
sections.body: Every order requires a deposit of {depositPercent}% of the order total, paid by bank transfer, InstaPay, or card where available. Pieces are held for {depositHoldHours} hours awaiting the deposit; if it is not received in that time the order lapses and the pieces are released. We do not offer cash on delivery for the full amount.

sections.title: Balance
sections.body: The remaining {balancePercent}% is due on delivery, before the pieces are handed over, and may be paid in cash, by transfer, or by card where available. Pieces cannot be released until the order is paid in full.

sections.title: Cancellations and refunds
sections.body: If the studio cannot fulfil a confirmed order, the deposit is refunded in full. If you cancel a confirmed order of in-studio pieces before dispatch, the deposit is refunded less any costs incurred. Deposits on made-to-order pieces are non-refundable once production has begun.

sections.title: Made to order
sections.body: Some pieces are made to order. Lead times are shown on the piece and confirmed with your order. Made-to-order pieces cannot be cancelled once production has begun.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.body: Pieces remain the property of NO FORM until paid in full. All designs are protected by copyright.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.body: We deliver across Egypt. Delivery fees depend on the governorate and are shown at checkout. Large pieces are delivered by the studio's courier partner and require someone to receive them.

sections.title: Timing
sections.body: In-studio pieces ship within 3–5 working days of confirmation. Made-to-order pieces follow the lead time shown on the piece.

sections.title: Inspection
sections.body: Inspect pieces on delivery. Note any damage on the courier's receipt and write to the studio within 48 hours with photographs.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: In-studio pieces may be returned within {days} days in their original condition. Return delivery is at the customer's cost unless the piece arrived damaged. Made-to-order pieces are final sale.

footer.line: Designed to shape space. Created to last.
